mapper.select: SELECT * FROM live2d_chat_config WHERE model_id=#{modelId} AND enabled=TRUE LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO live2d_chat_config (model_id, api_url, api_key, model_name, image_model_name, image_api_url, system_prompt, max_tokens, temperature, enabled, create_time) VALUES (#{modelId}, #{apiUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{modelName}, #{imageModelName}, #{imageApiUrl}, #{systemPrompt}, #{maxTokens}, #{temperature}, #{enabled}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE live2d_chat_config SET api_url=#{apiUrl}, api_key=#{apiKey}, model_name=#{modelName}, image_model_name=#{imageModelName}, image_api_url=#{imageApiUrl}, system_prompt=#{systemPrompt}, max_tokens=#{maxTokens}, temperature=#{temperature}, enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id}
